identity.engineering_client: SBM Offshore / Single Buoy Moorings Inc.

rule_application_policy: Never apply a PMC solely from its code; resolve area, governing document revision, service, pressure, temperature, material and classification first.
When two documents appear contradictory, do not silently choose the less stringent requirement; register the conflict and request the governing contractual hierarchy.
Project-specific blue-highlighted or revision-controlled modifications override the generic CES base specification for this project.
A numbered note applies only to the component or class row that references that note, unless the specification explicitly states broader applicability.
If a VDS, MDS, EDS or referenced detail is missing from the package, requirements dependent on it are not_verifiable.

area_router.action: Apply the Topsides PMC specification. It does not cover subsea pipelines, risers or cargo offloading hoses.
Apply the Vessel PMC specification for marine piping systems.

when.condition: required PMC is absent from Vessel specification or is not compatible with applicable ABS Vessel requirements

area_router.action: Use the Topsides PMC only as an explicitly documented cross-reference/deviation; do not assume automatic acceptance.
Apply ABS Rules for Building and Classing Steel Vessels. For an isolatable process-only portion, process criteria may start after the isolating valve, not including that valve.

when.condition: deviation from a PMC or project specification is proposed

then: avoid deviation where possible
treat as special piping item
identify on P&ID
obtain engineering approval

when.condition: a referenced standard edition is not contractually frozen

then: use the latest issue available at the contractual reference date
verify fluid or service
verify pressure and temperature
verify flow and environment
verify design life
verify classification regime
check risk of mixing dissimilar materials
confirm P&ID class reference

when.condition: a PMC row references VDS, MDS or EDS

then: load the referenced document
apply supplemental examination, testing, certification and component requirements
mark not_verifiable if unavailable

when.condition: material substitution is proposed due to availability, market or technical reasons

then: Piping Engineer evaluates substitution
verify required wall thickness
obtain approval before acceptance

when.condition: substitute is not explicitly listed in the accepted substitution table

then: do not reject automatically
require specific Piping Engineer approval and technical equivalence evidence
require 100 percent radiographic examination unless a later governing project rule explicitly replaces it
use the branch chart referenced by the active PMC
branch connection is prohibited unless COMPANY approval is documented
Package Engineer determines applicable CDR codes during bid stage
record applicable CDR codes on the purchase order

when.condition: PMC is Class I or Class II subject to project ABS requirements

then: verify whether pipes require ABS certification
verify whether fittings, flanges and valves require design approval
check component type approval or manufacturer testing evidence
full port is permitted only when indicated on the P&ID
use only when indicated on the P&ID
verify installation orientation when the class note restricts or permits position
seal weld after testing
cross-check the applicable piping detail specification
use RF weld-neck flanges only where explicitly permitted by the active class note

when.condition: RF flange mates to FF flange

then: use flat ring gasket when required by the active note
verify bolting and flange damage risk

when.condition: valve lining extends over the flange face

then: do not add a gasket when the active class note states no gasket is required

when.condition: component row references material certification note

then: require EN 10204 type 3.1 or project-revision equivalent stated in the governing specification
apply galvanizing, internal coating or lining after spool fabrication exactly as stated by the referenced note
do not generalize the treatment to classes without that note

project_specific_checks.title: Cross-area PMC code used without explicit basis
project_specific_checks.trigger: A Vessel drawing references a PMC code absent from the Vessel PMC but present in the Topsides PMC, or vice versa.
project_specific_checks.required_action: Confirm the intended governing class, service, classification basis and approved deviation/cross-reference.

project_specific_checks.title: Service code does not match the active PMC service index
project_specific_checks.trigger: Drawing service code and the service codes allowed or indexed for the active PMC do not reconcile.
project_specific_checks.required_action: Confirm P&ID service, selected class and engineering approval.

project_specific_checks.title: Outdated or mixed revision basis
project_specific_checks.trigger: Package mixes superseded and current project specifications without a document hierarchy or approved deviation.
project_specific_checks.required_action: Establish the contractual revision baseline before compliance evaluation.

cross_checks: Pipe and fittings must match the size-dependent EEMUA/ASTM material definitions in the class sheet.
Flange, backing flange, gasket and bolting selections must be reconciled as a complete joint set.
Do not use this Topsides class on a Vessel line solely because the code is 01K01.
